Name: Zechariah, Father of John the Baptist
Summary: Zechariah was a priest who, while burning incense in the Temple, was promised a son, John, yet was struck silent for his unbelief until the child's birth. His restored voice burst into prophetic praise.
KeyStory: At John's circumcision Zechariah wrote, His name is John, and immediately his mouth was opened and he prophesied over his son.
LifeLesson: Zechariah's season of silence ended in song. If God seems silent in your waiting, He is still working — and your voice of praise will return.
